name: Identify Successful Request (200 OK)
description: Verifies that the learner correctly identified Request R3 as the successful product catalog fetch returning status 200 OK.
rationale: Request R3 fetches /v1/products with a 200 OK status code and returns product catalog data.

name: Identify Missing Resource (404 Not Found)
description: Verifies that the learner correctly identified Request R4 as the missing image resource returning status 404 Not Found.
rationale: Request R4 points to a missing image path /images/products/phone_v2.png and receives a 404 Not Found response.

name: Identify Server Failure (500 Internal Server Error)
description: Verifies that the learner correctly identified Request R8 as the server-side backend crash returning status 500.
rationale: Request R8 to /v1/checkout/process crashed with HTTP 500 Internal Server Error due to a database exception.

name: Locate JSON Payload Content
description: Verifies that the learner inspected the JSON response body and correctly extracted error code DB_CONN_TIMEOUT.
rationale: The JSON response body of Request R8 contains { "error": "DatabaseConnectionException", "code": "DB_CONN_TIMEOUT" }.

name: Identify Insecure Plain HTTP Request
description: Verifies that the learner identified Request R7 as using unencrypted plain HTTP instead of secure HTTPS.
rationale: Request R7 to legacy-inventory.octostore uses the insecure http:// scheme over port 80.

name: Inspect Redirection Response Header (Location)
description: Verifies that the learner inspected response headers of Request R1 to find the target URL in the Location header.
rationale: The 301 Moved Permanently response for http://octostore.app includes header Location: https://octostore.app.
